latestChanges.finding: Private R2 read outage incorrectly triggered public bucket fallback
latestChanges.resolution: Fail closed with HTTP 503, without public read

latestChanges.finding: Stale product UPDATE/DELETE returned success plus phantom audit
latestChanges.resolution: Guard D1 changes count; conditional audit; HTTP 409 on stale writes

latestChanges.finding: Only static Admin handler authorization sweep existed
latestChanges.resolution: Dynamic 401/403 test of 31 protected handlers before DB access

latestChanges.finding: Backup Restore accepted whitespace, arrays or booleans as financial/integer fields through JavaScript coercion
latestChanges.resolution: Reject non-numeric JSON types and non-decimal integer strings before D1 write

latestChanges.finding: Backup Restore accepted payment ledger where refunded aggregate exceeds received aggregate for the same order
latestChanges.resolution: Validate net ledger per order before constructing destructive batch

latestChanges.finding: Payment POST coerced non-numeric JSON input into financial amounts
latestChanges.resolution: Only JSON numbers accepted; tests reject boolean/array/string before D1

latestChanges.finding: Warranty issuance coerced array/object/boolean values into durations
latestChanges.resolution: Strict number or decimal-only string validation for real FormData compatibility

latestChanges.finding: Admin order status saves with unchanged user-supplied prices could replay stale item prices after a concurrent reprice
latestChanges.resolution: Skip unchanged item updates and gate order summary update against exact preflight item/quantity/unit-price snapshot in the D1 batch

latestChanges.finding: Concurrent Admin repricing and status changes could overwrite stale data
latestChanges.resolution: Order-first snapshot compare-and-swap, status/item consistency and duplicate price rejection

latestChanges.finding: SQLite test fixture reset had not restored payment terms after the reprice scenario
latestChanges.resolution: Reset only disposable test fixture signed terms; business validation unchanged
